title: Constant environment, no objects, spp = 48: every pixel is exactly 1.0

tol.derivation: exact: samples are 1.0, a sum of 48 ones is exact in f32, mean f32(48/48) on the CPU
tol.source: WGSL §15.7.4 (correct rounding of a representable result is exact)

tol.derivation: (spp + 2) * u relative: one f32 rounding of L/Y(color), spp-1 additions, one luminance dot product
tol.source: photometric contract D6-A: radiance = L * color / Y(color), Y = BT.709 luma; u = 2^-23 (WGSL rounding direction unspecified, §15.7.4: faithful rounding)
